posts.title: iPhone Nono
posts.description: I admit, not without a bit of shame, that on the iPhone Duo pre-order day, I went into the pre-order queue. I was distracted and late so my delivery was estimated for end of January; a week or so ago I moved up to Dec 15th. posts.title: How Do You Design a Code Retreat in 2026?
posts.description: In November, it’s time for the Global Day of Code Retreat . That’s usually a day where surprisingly many (senior) developers leave their caves and congregate for Pizza and some TDD.
